description: Use after x402_session_start returns a valid session_id. Injects the stored session token and makes a covered request without a new payment. Do not use before initialize/session creation, as a payment bypass, after expiry, or for URLs outside the session scope.

body.description: Request body for POST/PUT/PATCH covered by this paid session.

headers.description: Additional request headers. The session token is injected automatically; do not supply private keys.

session_id.description: Session ID returned by x402_session_start. Required so AgentPay can attach the correct session token.

timeout_ms.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (default: 30000). The call returns an error instead of retrying payment on timeout.

url.description: Absolute URL to fetch. Must be covered by the session scope or the call fails closed.

name: x402_session_fetch
